headword: {応急手当|おうきゅうてあて}

definitions.explanation: Immediate, temporary care given to an injured or sick person on the spot, before a doctor or ambulance takes over. Includes stopping bleeding, bandaging, and cooling burns.

examples.japanese: {傷|きず}に{応急手当|おうきゅうてあて}をした。
examples.english: I gave first aid to the wound.

examples.japanese: けが{人|にん}に{応急手当|おうきゅうてあて}をしてから、{病院|びょういん}へ{運|はこ}んだ。
examples.english: We gave the injured person first aid and then took them to the hospital.

examples.japanese: やけどをしたら、まず{冷|ひ}やすのが{正|ただ}しい{応急手当|おうきゅうてあて}だ。
examples.english: If you get burned, cooling it first is the correct first-aid treatment.

notes:
"{応急|おうきゅう}" (emergency, stopgap) + "{手当|てあて}" (treatment). Refers to temporary on-the-spot care, not full medical treatment. Also written {応急処置|おうきゅうしょち}. Takes する: {応急手当|おうきゅうてあて}をする.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {応急手当|おうきゅうてあて}をする: to give first aid
- {応急手当|おうきゅうてあて}の{方法|ほうほう}: first-aid methods

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {応急処置|おうきゅうしょち}: emergency measures — near-synonym, slightly more formal and also used for objects/machines
- {手当|てあて}: treatment — the general word for medical care of a wound
